content.rationale: Git-tracked canonical JSON is the durable source of truth; derived indexes must remain rebuildable. Strict ID, project, manifest, shard, uniqueness, and relation-target validation prevents ambiguous or unsafe canonical state.
content.semantic_summary: feat(pitmry): establish canonical store: Closed Phase 1 of the PITMRY backend architecture rebuild: added the canonical store package, project-bound IDs and records, validated manifests and paths, immutable writes and duplicate detection, CLI validation and retrieval, and regression coverage. The canonical architecture docs and session record were included. The full server suite passed (96 tests), and commit 8157f5f was pushed to both GitLab and GitHub.
